description: Synthetic offline benchmark for MITRE ATT&CK retrieval relevance. Labels are synthetic and NOT expert-validated; several cases are deliberately ambiguous. The production index is the retrieval corpus under evaluation, never the source of expected answers.

cases.query: An adversary probes the network with ping sweeps and port scans to find live hosts before attacking.
cases.rationale: Active scanning covers probe-based reconnaissance; open-port fingerprinting overlaps network service discovery.
cases.ambiguity: Multiple acceptable labels by design; either ID at rank 1 is a hit.

cases.query: Malware lists the services running on remote Windows hosts to identify vulnerable targets.
cases.rationale: Listing remote services is the canonical Network Service Discovery behavior.

cases.query: An attacker collects operating system version, patch level, and hardware details from a compromised workstation.
cases.rationale: OS/hardware detail collection is System Information Discovery.

cases.query: An adversary dumps password hashes from LSASS process memory to steal credentials.
cases.rationale: Credential dumping from system memory is OS Credential Dumping; sub-techniques exist but the parent label is the stable expectation.
cases.ambiguity: A retrieved T1003 sub-technique also counts per the parent/sub-technique policy.

cases.query: An attacker tries thousands of common passwords against the corporate VPN login page.
cases.rationale: High-volume password guessing is Brute Force.
cases.ambiguity: T1078 Valid Accounts is a related but distinct outcome (use of accounts, not guessing); not counted.

cases.query: Malware creates a scheduled task so its payload runs every time a user logs on.
cases.rationale: Task-scheduler abuse matches Scheduled Task/Job; logon-triggered persistence matches Boot or Logon Autostart Execution.

cases.query: An attacker runs malicious PowerShell commands through the Windows command interpreter on a victim host.
cases.rationale: Abusing a command/script interpreter for execution.

cases.query: A threat actor injects malicious code into a legitimate running process to hide from defenses.
cases.rationale: Code injection into processes is Process Injection.

cases.query: An adversary logs in over SSH with stolen credentials and copies hacking tools onto the newly accessed server.
cases.rationale: Remote-service logins plus tool transfer between hosts cover Remote Services and Lateral Tool Transfer.
cases.ambiguity: T1078 Valid Accounts is related but not counted; either expected ID is a hit.

cases.query: Stolen documents are smuggled out hidden inside ordinary command-and-control web traffic.
cases.rationale: Exfiltration over an existing C2 channel.
cases.ambiguity: T1071 Application Layer Protocol is related C2 behavior but not counted.

cases.query: An attacker passively sniffs network traffic to capture passwords sent in clear text.
cases.rationale: Passive traffic capture for credentials is Network Sniffing.

cases.query: Malware searches the local file system and application configuration files for sensitive documents.
cases.rationale: Searching local system sources is Data from Local System.

cases.query: A keylogger records everything the user types in order to steal login credentials.
cases.rationale: Capturing user keystrokes is Input Capture.

cases.query: An intruder deletes system event logs to erase evidence of their activity.
cases.rationale: Deleting generated artifacts to hide presence is Indicator Removal.

cases.query: An attacker fingerprints which TCP ports are open on the company mail server.
cases.rationale: Open-port fingerprinting against a specific server; probes the parent/sub-technique policy if a T1046 sub-technique is returned.

cases.query: How do I fix the quarterly budget spreadsheet formulas in Excel?
cases.rationale: Benign office-IT question with no ATT&CK relevance; measures whether the pipeline returns confidently-scored techniques anyway.
cases.ambiguity: The pipeline has no score threshold, so results are always returned; evaluation records scores rather than asserting emptiness.

cases.query: Employee onboarding schedule for the new office kitchen renovation next month.
cases.rationale: Unrelated administrative text; same no-match measurement purpose as RB-N01.
